This is a **Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript** full-stack application with a **MongoDB** backend. It appears to be a **Q&A / question-bank platform** with public submission, admin review, and exam-type management.

**Main components:**
- `app/` – Next.js App Router pages and API endpoints
  - `page.tsx` (home), `login/`, `admin/` (admin dashboard)
  - `api/` – serverless backend routes: `questions/[id]`, `questions/submit`, `exam-types`, `seed-exam-types`, `update-existing-questions`
- `components/` – React components:
  - `ui/` – shadcn-style primitives (button, card, input, select, toast, etc.)
  - `admin/` – admin question list, pending approvals list
  - `home/` – public submission modal
  - `auth-provider`, `theme-provider`, `theme-toggle`, `question-card`, `pagination`, `exam-type-selector`
- `lib/` – core utilities and business logic:
  - `mongodb.ts` (DB connection), `types.ts` (domain types), `utils.tsx`
- `hooks/` – `use-toast` (toast notifications)
- `scripts/` – standalone Node/TS scripts for seeding exam types and migrating existing questions

**Business logic:**
- Resides primarily in `lib/`, `app/api/` routes, and `scripts/` (for migrations/seeding). The UI components in `components/` handle presentation, while API routes handle data operations and validation.

**Tests:**
- **No test directories or test files are present** (no Jest, Playwright, Cypress, Vitest, etc.).

**Tech stack:**
- Next.js 14+ (App Router, `next.config.mjs`)
- TypeScript (`tsconfig.json`)
- MongoDB via Mongoose/DB client (`lib/mongodb.ts`)
- Tailwind CSS (`globals.css`, `postcss.config.mjs`)
- shadcn/ui component patterns (`components.json`, Radix-based `ui/` components)

The application supports public question submission, admin review/approval, question categorization by exam type, and paginated browsing, with authentication for admin functions.
